newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI TAKES GIRO FIRST STAGE AT THE LINE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI TAKES GIRO FIRST STAGE AT THE LINE.

text.p: Italy's Mario Cipollini snatched the opening stage of the 80th Giro d'Italia on Saturday.
After battling shoulder-to-shoulder with Nicola Minali over the final metres he edged out his compatriot and still found time to throw up his arms in salute as he crossed the line.
Endrio Leoni took third place for an all-Italian finish to the 128-km race over an eight-kilometre circuit.
Cipollini's stage victory, his ninth of the year, earned him a time deduction of 12 seconds with Minali taking eight seconds and Leoni four.
Simone Borgheresi, team mate of leading contender Marco Pantani, crashed as the speed topped 60 kmh and was taken to hospital with a suspected fractured collarbone.
